question: Should the new diagnostic event fields and documented OTEL attribute names be accepted as the supported telemetry contract for model-call context pressure?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but its field naming and observability semantics become externally consumed contract surface, and the PR carries an explicit maintainer gate.

options.title: Approve additive telemetry contract
options.body: Accept the current sanitized fields and OTEL names, including omission of ambiguous Codex completed-turn classifications.

options.title: Narrow or rename before release
options.body: Adjust the event fields, attribute names, or prompt-utilization semantics before downstream dashboards depend on them.

recommendation.title: Approve additive telemetry contract
recommendation.body: Accept the current sanitized fields and OTEL names, including omission of ambiguous Codex completed-turn classifications.
